text:
sam: Quick update — started FP8 kernel enablement branch tests on H100 and L40S. goal is to validate runtime invariants before canary.
liam: Nice. which model/config are you using?
sam: running stable-7b and a trimmed 13b convai set, seq_len=2048, default kv cache settings.
anya: FYI saw small NaN spike in earlier runs on long seqs — could be activation scaling.
kai: Can you paste the run command? trying to reproduce on my dev rig.
sam: Sure:
```
export REDWOOD_FP8_ENABLE=1
export FP8_ACT_SCALE=dynamic
./serve --model stable-7b --kernel fp8 --device h100 --seq 2048 --batch 8
```
dana: infra-bot reported one GPU OOM on L40S at batch 12 during auto-batching. infra-bot: (deployment id rwd-fp8-112, event: OOM_GPU_0)
liam: OOM at batch 12 — sounds like kernel's workspace size differs between H100 and L40S kernels. L40S driver/allocator uses slightly different max workspace calculation.
anya: Also saw slight polarisation: layernorm scale drift on a subset of heads when mixed-precision fallback triggered for matmul kernels.
kai: Is the fallback happening due to negative scaling values? any logs?
sam: logs snippet:
```
[fp8-runtime] layer 23: activation_scale=1.02e-6 clamp->0.0, fallback to BF16_kernel
[fp8-runtime] kv_cache: mismatch predicted_size=1.3G actual=1.1G
```
liam: That clamp->0.0 looks suspect — we should avoid hard clamping to zero, prefer epsilon floor. leads to effective zeroing and softmax collapse.
dana: Filing a ticket for allocator differences. I'll assign to eng-infra.
bench-bot: eval summary (stable-7b, 1k eval samples): FP8 enabled vs baseline BF16: perplexity +0.92 (worse), exact-match on short QA -0.4%, generation fluency unchanged.
anya: +0.92 perplexity is small but consistent on prompt set with many long prefixes. That matches NaN/scale observations.
kai: Possible mitigations: per-layer fp8 scaling (learned/static), increase act_scale floor, and disable fp8 for first N layers as a canary.
sam: I tested disabling FP8 on first 2 layers: perplexity delta improved to +0.2, NaNs vanished. CPU latency +5% though.
liam: Tradeoff seems acceptable for canary. For L40S need to tune workspace carveouts too.
anya: Also watch KV cache alignment — one mismatch causes silent corruption with mixed-precision. We should add a checksum on serialize/deserialize of KV pages in canary.
dana: Agree. I'll add KV checksum flag to canary config. infra-bot: canary created rwd-canary-45 with 2% traffic to dedicated-h100 and 1% to dedicated-l40s.
sam: Next steps: (1) infra: pin workspace calc on L40S and expose env tunable (owner: dana), (2) runtime: change clamp->epsilon and per-layer fp8 opt-out (owner: liam), (3) ml: run 10k eval and check long-seq regressions (owner: anya), (4) bench: produce latency/cost delta table (owner: bench-bot).
liam: I'll also add an invariant check that throws during CI if any layer's act_scale < 1e-7 to avoid silent collapse.
anya: One more note — quantization config has an AWQ/GPTQ fallback path we can default to for thin layers; might help for 13b.
kai: Good point. We should document the rollout checklist in the runbook.
sam: I'll draft a short runbook gist tonight and ping the group. tagging @everyone for visibility :eyes:
liam: Thanks — if anyone reproduces the NaN locally ping me with logs and a minimal repro.
dana: Filing infra tickets now.
bench-bot: scheduled nightly long-seq sweep on canary for next 48 hours.
(reacts: :thumbsup: from sam, :rocket: from anya)
